$comment: Client-half build. Separate from tsconfig.json on purpose: this half is a browser **script**
that registers a lazy-CJS factory on window.__ModuleLoader__, so it needs the DOM lib, no
Node types, and CommonJS emit — while the host half is ESM with node types. One config
`rootDir: src/client` + `outDir: lib` is what puts the bundle at exactly `lib/client.js`
(the path package.json exports as ./client and the path the client-modules scan reads from
`exports['./client']`): the entry source is `src/client/client.ts`. The main config excludes
`src/client`, so the two builds never write the same file.
`alwaysStrict: false` is deliberate: `strict` would otherwise emit a `"use strict";` prologue,
and these bundles are concatenated into one combo script by the host (`comboSource`/`buildCombo`
in dsh-client-modules/lib/index.js). A directive prologue at the top of that combo would put
every other plugin's factory in strict mode. No installed client bundle carries one; ours
